description: This file is part of the TestLink open source project and contains PHP code for comparing different versions of requirements. It includes functions for fetching requirement details, preparing diffs, initializing page components, and generating user feedback related to requirement version comparisons.

methods.name: getBareBonesReq
methods.description: Fetches minimal requirement details from the database given a requirement ID.

methods.name: getItemsToCompare
methods.description: Retrieves the specific items to compare based on their item IDs from the provided item set.

methods.name: getCFToCompare
methods.description: Retrieves linked custom fields for the items to be compared within a specific test project.

methods.name: getCFDiff
methods.description: Compares linked custom fields between two requirement sides and detects differences, considering field types and formatting.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request parameters and comparison options from input variables.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI component with user history, labels, and requirement type configuration for the comparison page.

methods.name: prepareUserFeedback
methods.description: Prepares and attaches detailed user feedback and requirement identifiers for the diff comparison view.

methods.name: getAttrDiff
methods.description: Generates attribute-level differences (status, type, coverage) between two requirement sides with language decoding.
